a visit (Longman iv 374–7, no. 408)) will have dovetailed aptly with the Byronic stimulus.
 Friday 25 January is described in Williams’s journal as ‘Rain — heavy during the whole day’
(Gisborne Jnl 127), and S. appears to have spent much of that day at his desk, writing a long
letter to Leigh Hunt, and others to his banker, and to Horace Smith, asking him to purchase
a pedal harp on his behalf intended as a gift for Jane (L ii 378–380; see headnote to With a
guitar. To Jane). Jane’s 24th birthday had fallen four days earlier on 21 January, which may
have stimulated S. to a more concentrated consideration of his gathering feelings for her,
